name: Hytale
description: Adopt an existing Hytale dedicated server directory and run HytaleServer.jar directly, then manage its mods.
known_limitations: GameNode cannot install Hytale: the server files come from Hytale's official downloader, which needs an interactive account login. Download them yourself, then adopt the folder.
The server needs Java 25 and its own account authentication; run /auth login device in the server Console tab after the first start.
GameNode runs the server from the folder you select, so config.json, mods/ and universe/ live there; move existing data there if you ran it from elsewhere.
No configuration adapter yet: config.json key names are not documented and have changed between early-access builds. Edit it in the Files tab.

config_files.description: Server configuration created by the server on first start; edit it in the Files tab.

requirements.description: Java (25 recommended by Hytale) must be available through JAVA_HOME or PATH.
Obtain the server with Hytale's official downloader and select the folder containing Server/HytaleServer.jar and Assets.zip.

help.summary: GameNode inspects the selected folder, then launches Java directly with structured arguments; it never downloads Hytale files or handles your account login.
notes: After the first start, run /auth login device in the server Console tab to authenticate the server.
Mods (.jar plugins and .zip packs) are managed on the server Mods tab.

prerequisites: An existing Hytale dedicated server folder (Server/HytaleServer.jar and Assets.zip)
Java available through JAVA_HOME or PATH
